title: Unable to recover correct route after returning to junction
description: Tester successfully chose a wrong route, turned around, and returned toward the previous junction, but could not recover onto the correct mission route within the 60 second stage timeout.
reproduction: Attempt to choose the correct route
expected: The player should be able to return to the previous junction and select the correct route.
actual: The tester could not confirm correctRouteRecovered before the 60 second timeout.
developerNotes: Fixed return-to-junction branch reset condition in src/main.js. Previously, returning to a junction along a branch checked delta < -8, which was impossible because distance along the branch is positive (delta >= 0). Updated condition to check Math.abs(delta) <= 8 when reverse-aligned with branch tangent, allowing the cart to return to junction hub, reset isOnWrongRoute to false, and select the correct outgoing route.
